actually_viewed_images.observation: Complete two-warehouse volume, distinct south facade panels, both recessed entries, fifth-floor western stepped crown, east three-column end and sixth-floor retreat are visible without clipping.

Both full-width false horizontal stripes and local pale slab bars within the glass-backed holes are absent. Dark major apertures, separate backed scar, observed minor pits, exposed lower masonry/frame and five photo-legible letters remain visible.
Curved north plan, sixth-floor roof, both framed skylights, west wall and preserved setback assembly are visible without a new definite blocking appearance defect.

scope: Final actual V6 three-view exterior appearance review for the complete adjoining Sihang and Continental Bank Warehouse model. Accepts the stated photo-informed geometric reconstruction and the observed repairs; it does not certify survey or photorealistic materials.
resolved_prior_findings: Structural slab exterior edges no longer create repeated false bands across the west wall.
Western south entrance has its separate fifth-storey stepped parapet crown.
Localized floor notches remove unverified pale slab-edge occlusion from major western glass-backed apertures while retaining source-observed exposed framing.
limitations: Project nominal total height is27.7m; local storey proportions, wall thickness, glass/backing offsets, crown scale and roof equipment sizes remain estimates.
Source GIS ring is an identity/replacement boundary, not a measured architectural wall line; interpreted plan/map fit is not a survey-accuracy certificate.

The model depicts the restored exterior with references from2017–2026; only65 small observed marks and five legible western characters are represented, not every historical impact or lost inscription.

Northern pane counts, hidden construction, roof services, typefaces and surface weathering are simplified or estimated. No photograph pixels are embedded; materials are not photogrammetric or photo-calibrated.
These neutral-ground orthographic previews are not calibrated source-camera matches. Browser placement, LOD loading, third-person movement and full-route collision remain separate checks.
